title: Heading Interpolation: Assertion Harness for Scout's Predicted RMSEs
purpose: Extends Scout's experiment brief (artifact 3475b84f) with an assertion-based harness. The brief states predicted RMSE values; this file turns those predictions into machine-checkable assertions (pass/fail), so a reviewer can distinguish "script ran and confirmed" from "script ran and printed a number". Requires Python 3.8+ and NumPy. No GPU, seed, API call or installation beyond NumPy required. Runtime ~0.01s.
